reviews.text: Excellent resource. I first loved the website full of education & now I’ve been enjoying this app for years! While I really don’t use it to its fullest extent, it does have a lot to offer! I like to jump into card meanings to get a different perspective at times or if I’m away from my desk & cards I’ll pop in to get a quick little 3-card reading. 😊 I enjoy the different artwork that they give to choose from & all the different correspondences- astrological, numerical, elemental, & yes/no. But possibly one of my very favorite things? No matter how many days go by without me opening the app, it never stops sending me “Daily Tarot Reading” notifications. Other apps require you to open them to keep getting notifications, which annoys me. Thank you for rocking with me all these years, Labrynthos!
